cost_budgets_mode.title: Cost Budgets Mode
cost_budgets_mode.description: Off leaves requests untouched and blocks nothing, so it is a true rollback. Observe tracks spend per project and user without ever blocking a call, which is the safe way to measure real usage before choosing limits. Enforce rejects calls once a limit is exceeded.

cost_budgets_project_warning_pct.title: Team Project Budget Warning Threshold (%)
cost_budgets_project_warning_pct.description: Show a usage alert when a team project's spend reaches this percentage of its budget limit.

cost_budgets_personal_project_warning_pc.title: Personal Project Budget Warning Threshold (%)
cost_budgets_personal_project_warning_pc.description: Show a usage alert when a user's own project spend reaches this percentage of its budget limit.

cost_budgets_user_warning_pct.title: Default Per-Member Budget Warning Threshold (%)
cost_budgets_user_warning_pct.description: Show a usage alert when a member's spend inside a team project reaches this percentage of their own budget limit.
